comment: fx_delay at 375 ms with 40 % feedback, 35 % wet. delayTime is in SECONDS (the patch multiplies by 1000 and floors at 1 ms). The two shelf gains are -200 and not 0 for the same reason as the distortion: plan section 5.13 defects P1/P2 mean a nominal 0 dB shelf adds about +0.5 dB PER REPEAT inside the feedback loop, which our module cannot and should not reproduce. The corners are inside our ranges so nothing is clamped. modDepth is 0 because MultitapDelayModule has no LFO phase control and its sine is a quarter cycle from the prototype's cosine.
